question: What sequence follows when the power is placed up to the crown in the prepared disciple?
premises: The power is placed up to the crown.
It then falls in a definite sequence.
The disciple has been sprinkled and prepared by the prescribed path-purification method.
inference: For the properly prepared disciple, placing the power up to the crown produces a corresponding descending sequence.
uncertainties: The exact technical meaning of the descending sequence is not fully spelled out in the verse.
plain_english: One should place it up to the crown; then it falls, and by that a definite sequence occurs for the sprinkled disciple in whom the prescribed method of path-purification has been laid down.
